title: Laragon local development
summary: Local development for MyAPES Account runs on Laragon again, with demo data and a live preview, and milestones and releases are now named after their version.
changes: Laragon 8 on Windows is the supported local setup, replacing WampServer. The app runs as its own Laragon project at http://myapes-account.test, with a recorded profile, a composer setup script, repeatable en_GB demo data (composer demo:seed and demo:reset) and Vite hot reload on port 5175.

Milestone branches, pull requests, release records, tags and release titles are now named from the version at the start of the milestone title, never from GitHub's milestone number. A new agent rule sets this out, and the agent instructions, contributing guide and developer wiki point to it.
GitHub Releases are now titled with the version and the milestone's label, for example v0.58.3 Dev, instead of the version followed by Beta.
New composer milestone commands show the next milestone and check pull request titles, branch names and release titles, and a CI check runs the title and branch checks on every pull request.
version_rationale: Patch: developer tooling, release naming and documentation only. No change to what users see or to the live app.
validation: The full pre-PR verification (release history against main, version-pinned and contract tests, frontend tests and build, Laragon setup) passed locally, and the app loaded at http://myapes-account.test on Laragon.
The release title step was checked against the live milestone titles, and the deploy workflow contract tests cover it.
known_limitations: Three open milestones (v0.53.0, v0.55.0 and v0.56.0) have versions at or below the latest release and need retitling before they can ship.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Nothing in the database changes in this release.
provenance: Milestone v0.58.3 Dev: Laragon local development, epic #723 with sub-issues #722, #725 and #726, pull requests #724, #727, #728 and #729.
